about: Bracebridge is a town in Muskoka District, Ontario, where the Muskoka River drops over Bracebridge Falls in the downtown core. Cottage-country tourism, a historic main street, and year-round service roles for lake communities shape the place. Highways 11 and 118 bring travellers from the GTA into the district. About 17,000 people live in Bracebridge.
seoSummary: Muskoka town known for Bracebridge Falls on the Muskoka River and cottage-country services.
knownFor: Bracebridge Falls in the downtown core
